items.label: STURDY CONSTRUCTION
items.value: This computer desk is manufactured from E0-grade board and stainless steel legs. The thickened golden metal frame ensures the super stability and 0.59" thicker board is strong enough to support heavy duty load; The adjustable foot pads keep the large office desk stable on uneven ground and protect the floor from scratch.

items.label: SPACIOUS TABLETOP
items.value: Measuring 63” W x 31.5” D , this conference table provides ample space for laptops, projector, files, and other office supplies. It’s comfortable for 4-6 co-workers and colleagues to brainstorm, leadership meetings and small team collaborations. Besides, several meeting room tables can be put together to form a larger workspace when in need.

items.label: SUPERIOR MATERIAL
items.value: This white and gold executive desk adopts the faux marble particle board as the tabletop, which is easy to clean, waterproof, anti-abrasion, and heat-resistant. The scratch-resistant laminate finish protects the desk's surface from daily wear and tear while the waterproof function eliminates your concern about spilling water or drinks.

items.label: MULTIPURPOSE TABLE
items.value: Designed in perfect size, simple style and faux marble white color, this modern office desk blends well with any decoration. It can bring a touch of elegance and charming to your space. More than a writing desk at study room, this computer desk can also be used as a dining table in the kitchen or as a executive desk in the office.

items.label: EASY ASSEMBLE
items.value: Coming with quite clear instructions, numbered parts and all necessary tools, this large office desk could be easily assembled. We provide great assurance and professional customer service both before and after your purchase by responding in 24 hours.
